\documentclass{article}
\newcommand{\rec}{\rec\rec}
\begin{document}
Let $\beta>0$, where $u(x) = w(x) + 1$ and with $w(x) = u(x) - 1$.
\begin{equation}
g(x) = h(x) + x
\label{eq:g}
\end{equation}
\begin{equation}
h(x) = g(x) - x
\label{eq:h}
\end{equation}
\begin{equation}
g(x) - h(x) = x
\label{eq:gh}
\end{equation}
\begin{equation}
u(y) - w(y) = 1
\label{eq:uw}
\end{equation}
\begin{equation}
\rec = 1
\label{eq:rec}
\end{equation}
\begin{equation}
\int_0^{\infty} dt\, t^{3} e^{-\beta t}\cos(\beta t) = \frac{-1}{2\beta^{4}} \cdot 0 + \int_0^1 dx
\label{eq:mix}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
